definitions.explanation: An irregular surface with bumps and depressions.
Two things or people that are very different from each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦にくい→にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: The road is bumpy and hard to walk on.

examples.japanese: {凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: They're an odd couple and funny.

examples.japanese: ⟦{表面|ひょうめん}→表面：03587_hyoumen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}す→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
examples.english: I fix the unevenness of the surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦にくい→にくい：02005_nikui⟧。
examples.english: The road became bumpy from the rain, making it hard to ride a bicycle.
The mismatched pair of a tall person and a short person is popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正反対|せいはんたい}→正反対：14724_seihantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}っている→合う：10466_au⟧。
examples.english: Their personalities are polar opposites, but they work well together as an odd couple.

notes:
{凸凹|でこぼこ} describes uneven surfaces or mismatched pairs.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: bumpy road
- {凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦コンビ→コンビ：27903_konbi⟧: mismatched pair, odd couple
- {凸凹|でこぼこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have bumps

WRITING:
Also commonly written in hiragana (でこぼこ). The kanji 凸凹 visually represent the bumps (凸) and dips (凹).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ガタガタ→がたがた：05274_gatagata⟧: rattling, rough
- ⟦{平|たい}ら→平ら：03399_taira⟧: flat, even
